packageRules.description: sylius/sylius keeps its lower bound at 2.2.9. Consumers on Sylius 2.2 (commerce, held there because sylius/paypal-plugin has no release for 2.3) must be able to install this package; a pinup range bump to ^2.3.0 locked them out of every later release. widen appends new majors/minors instead of raising the floor. Remove when every consumer runs Sylius 2.3 or later.
